## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Release notes

Include a changeset for a user-visible package change, or explain why none is needed.

## Verification

List relevant checks and regression tests.

## Integration report, when applicable

- Report and app reproduction: Refs #
- Ownership and regression test:
- Release containing the fix: pending
- Original app version, commit, and workflow verification: pending

Do not mark consumer verification complete until the app uses the released fix.
